message: Automated scans are not configured yet. Add VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY as a GitLab CI/CD variable, then re-run the virus-scan job (or publish a release tag).
limitations: macOS builds are unsigned — Gatekeeper may warn until notarized.
Windows builds are unsigned — SmartScreen / Defender may warn on first run.
VirusTotal aggregates many engines; a single unknown/heuristic hit is common for new unsigned software and is not proof of malware.
